description: This file implements the MediaKeySession class and related factory functions for managing media key sessions, including creation, request generation, challenge handling, decryption, and session management within a DRM context.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating media key session factories.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MediaKeySession instances.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Represents a media key session handling DRM operations such as request generation, decryption, and session management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeySessionFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new MediaKeySession object with specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a media key session with provided parameters.

methods.name: ~MediaKeySession
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up session resources.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on init data.

methods.name: getChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data from the session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes and destructs the key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes the key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the session contains a specific key.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: onProcessChallenge
methods.description: Handles processing of license challenge data.

methods.name: onKeyUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to keys.

methods.name: onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles notification that all keys are updated.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors reported by OCDM.

methods.name: initOcdmErrorChecking
methods.description: Initializes error checking for OCDM operations.

methods.name: checkForOcdmErrors
methods.description: Checks if an OCDM error has occurred during an operation.
